texts.preamble: Dashrath Sahu S/O Ramdev Sahu vs State Of Rajasthan on 5 July, 2021 Author: Devendra Kachhawaha Bench: Devendra Kachhawaha High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 5064/2021 1.
texts.facts: The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the petitioners apprehending their arrest in connection with F.I.R. No.27/2021, Police Station Kekri, Distt. Ajmer for the offences under Sections 143, 332, 353, 341, 506 of IPC and Sections 16(1) (G) (D) and Section 62 of Food Safety and Standard Act. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. in connection with FIR No.27/2021 registered at Police Station Kekri, District Ajmer for the offence(s) under Sections 143, 332, 353, 341, 506 of IPC and Sections 16(1)(G)(D) and Section 62 of Food Safety and Standard Act. 2. Counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners have been wrongly implicated in this case. Similarly situated co-accused Anil Mittal has been enlarged on anticipatory bail by this Court and case of the petitioners is similar to him. Nothing is to be recovered from the petitioners.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners appearing through video conferencing stated that benefit of anticipatory bail has already been granted to co-accused Anil Mittal by the co-ordinate bench of this Court; allegation against the petitioners are similar to that of the co-accused, therefore, benefit of anticipatory bail may be granted to the accused-petitioners. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners have joined investigation as per direction of this Court.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners appearing through video conferencing stated that benefit of anticipatory bail has already been granted to co-accused Anil Mittal by the co-ordinate bench of this Court; allegation against the petitioners are similar to that of the co-accused, therefore, benefit of anticipatory bail may be granted to the accused-petitioners. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners have joined investigation as per direction of this Court.
